value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#14
value.text: John Garrett teases Fitz with gallows humor on the mission to save Skye.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist Garrett teases on the Guest House mission.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A senior agent who jokes with Fitz.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#17
split.text: Garrett is exposed as Hydra's Clairvoyant and offers Fitz a place in Hydra, which Fitz refuses.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist Garrett teases, who refuses to join Hydra.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A senior agent who jokes with Fitz, then turns out to be the Clairvoyant.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#21
split.text: After Fitz is captured, he hits Garrett with an EMP device that wrecks his cybernetics and leaves him near death.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist Garrett teases, who hits him with an EMP that nearly kills him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A senior agent who jokes with Fitz, then turns out to be the Clairvoyant.

verdicts.why: The S1#14 teasing ('Humor, son. You Brits are too serious') and S1#21 EMP are right, but Garrett is exposed and offers Fitz a place in Hydra in S1#17, so an ally stage cannot run to S1#21; the exposure gets its own enemy stage at S1#17.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#14
value.text: John Garrett works alongside May's team as a trusted senior agent.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent on the team Garrett works with.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#17
split.text: Garrett is exposed as the Clairvoyant and the head of Hydra's Centipede program, and May helps capture him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who helps capture Garrett once he is exposed.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A trusted senior agent who turns out to be the Clairvoyant.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#22
split.text: May helps the team bring Garrett down at Cybertek.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who helps bring Garrett down once he is exposed.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A trusted senior agent who turns out to be the Clairvoyant.

verdicts.why: S1#14 start and S1#17 exposure and capture are right, but the S1#17 split said 'later helps bring him down at Cybertek', which is S1#22; that part becomes its own stage.
Garrett first appears in S1#14 and Fury, thought dead until then, first shares a scene with him at Cybertek in S1#22, where the whole stage text (old supervising officer, takedown) holds.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#14
value.text: John Garrett and Phil Coulson were partners and friends at S.H.I.E.L.D. for years.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#17
split.text: Garrett turns out to be the Clairvoyant and Hydra, and Coulson knocks him out and has him arrested.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Garrett's longtime partner and friend, who arrests him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's longtime partner and friend, who turns out to be the Clairvoyant.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#22
split.text: Coulson kills Garrett at Cybertek.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Garrett's longtime partner and friend, who kills him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's longtime partner and friend, who turns out to be the Clairvoyant.

verdicts.why: The S1#14 start and S1#17 exposure are right, but Coulson vaporizes Garrett only in S1#22, so the S1#17 split's 'later kills him' and its card lines are a spoiler; the killing gets its own stage.
Hand orders Simmons and Triplett to work at the Hub as consultants in S1#16; she poses as Hydra to test their loyalty in S1#17.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#2
value.text: Kasius forces Jemma Simmons to serve him on the Lighthouse as a slave, silencing her with an implant.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Kree who keeps Jemma as a slave.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A human Kasius keeps as a slave.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#6
split.text: Jemma slashes Kasius across the face as she escapes with Fitz.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Kree who keeps Jemma as a slave. She tries to kill him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A human Kasius keeps as a slave, who tries to kill him.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#10
split.text: Jemma turns Kasius's own silencing device on him so Mack can kill him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Kree who keeps Jemma as a slave. She tries to kill him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A human Kasius keeps as a slave, who tries to kill him.

verdicts.why: S5#2 implant and S5#6 slash are right, but the S5#6 split also told of the deafening and Kasius's death, which are S5#10; that part becomes its own stage.
May shoots Hunter before he can fire on Simmons, Coulson's mole whom he has never met, in Morocco in S2#3; Simmons is rescued and back with the team in S2#5.
The friendship holds from S1#1; Ward ejects the pod at the end of S1#21 and the underwater confession and oxygen are S1#22.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#4
value.text: Fitz follows the team into the future to find Jemma.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Jemma's boyfriend, who follows her into the future.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's girlfriend, whom he follows into the future.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#12
split.text: Back home, Fitz and Jemma marry.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Jemma's husband, who follows her to the future and marries her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's wife, whom he follows into the future and marries.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
split.text: Fitz is killed in the battle against Glenn Talbot, though another Fitz still sleeps in cryostasis out in space.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Jemma's husband, who follows her to the future, marries her, then is killed.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's wife, whom he follows into the future and marries before he dies.

verdicts.why: S5#4 and the S5#12 wedding are right, but Fitz dies and the sleeping Fitz comes up only in S5#22, so the S5#12 split was a spoiler; the death gets its own stage.
Fitz returns at the end of S7#12; Alya is revealed and Fitz and Simmons leave to raise her only in S7#13.
Simmons is on the S2#19 team that frees Peterson and Lincoln from Hydra's base; she questions Lincoln and puts him on the Index in S2#20.
Fury heads S.H.I.E.L.D. from S1 on, but he pulls Fitz and Simmons from the ocean only in S1#22.
Coulson dies in S5#22; Simmons reveals the Coulson LMD at the end of S6#13 and shows it woken to Mack and Daisy in S7#1.
Simmons has Piper guard the module holding Alya in S7#13 (What We're Fighting For).

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#5
value.text: Raina spots Jemma leaving Hydra's labs, watches her report back to S.H.I.E.L.D., and blows her cover as a mole.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The woman who blows Jemma's cover as a mole in Hydra.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A S.H.I.E.L.D. mole in Hydra, whose cover Raina blows.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#11
split.text: Jemma fires at Raina's transformed body, but the bullets barely hurt her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Inhuman who blows Jemma's cover as a mole in Hydra.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A S.H.I.E.L.D. mole in Hydra, whose cover Raina blows.

verdicts.why: The S2#5 move and S2#11 split are right, but the S2#5 stage kept Jemma's card calling Raina 'The Inhuman', and Raina only goes through Terrigenesis in S2#10.
Ghost Rider saves Daisy and Simmons from Hellfire in S4#4; the Eli Morrow fight is S4#8.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#16
value.text: After his faction takes over the Playground, Robert Gonzales tells Jemma Simmons he once hoped to recruit her and asks her and Fitz to open Coulson's Toolbox. Jemma pretends to agree so Fitz can get away with it, staying loyal to Coulson.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The rival director who wants Jemma to open Coulson's Toolbox.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A scientist Gonzales once hoped to recruit, who stays loyal to Coulson.

verdicts.why: S2#16 is right for the recruiting line and the Toolbox ruse, but the S2#19 split is wrong: Gonzales sent the Toolbox to Weaver and Simmons in S2#15, and in S2#19 Coulson opens it for him with no part for Simmons. So it is one stage at S2#16 with no split.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#17
value.text: Ruby Hale captures Jemma and Fitz and threatens to kill Jemma unless they repair Hydra's Gravitonium chamber.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Hydra captor who forces Jemma onto Gravitonium work.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A scientist Ruby forces to work on Gravitonium.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#18
split.text: Jemma warns Ruby where it leads, having seen that future herself, but Ruby will not listen and grabs her by the throat.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A Hydra captor who forces Jemma onto Gravitonium work, then chokes her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A scientist Ruby forces to work on Gravitonium, who warns her where it leads.

verdicts.why: The capture and threat are at the end of S5#17, but the episode guides put Jemma's warning and Ruby grabbing her throat in S5#18 (All Roads Lead...), so those move to an S5#18 stage.
Bakshi questions Simmons, takes her to Morocco and backs her promotion in S2#3; he dies saving Ward in S2#19.
Their months on Maveth and falling in love are told in S3#5 (4,722 Hours); Hive wearing Will's body is revealed in S3#10.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#16
value.text: Jiaying welcomed Lincoln Campbell to Afterlife and granted him Terrigenesis, and he helps her daughter Skye through her change there. He sides with her at first.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An Inhuman Jiaying welcomes to Afterlife.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#18
split.text: Jiaying sends Lincoln to watch over Skye when she leaves Afterlife with Cal.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An Inhuman Jiaying welcomes and sets to watch her daughter.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Lincoln's mentor at Afterlife.

verdicts.why: Both are first seen together at Afterlife in S2#16, where Lincoln is Skye's transitioner, but Jiaying assigns him to watch over Skye only in S2#18, so that part moves to an S2#18 stage.
Jiaying agrees to meet S.H.I.E.L.D., then kills Gonzales to start the war in S2#20; Coulson loses his hand stopping the crystals in S2#22.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#16
value.text: Jiaying takes Raina into Afterlife after her transformation and stops Skye from hurting her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An Inhuman Jiaying takes into Afterlife.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The leader who takes Raina in.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#21
split.text: Jiaying is fascinated by Raina's visions of the future. When Raina sets out to expose Jiaying's plan to wipe out humanity, she provokes Jiaying into killing her so Skye will see the truth.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The seer Jiaying takes in, who provokes Jiaying into killing her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The leader who takes Raina in, whom she goads into killing her.

verdicts.why: The S2#16 start and S2#21 split are right, but the S2#16 card still called Raina 'The seer', and her visions only appear from S2#17 to S2#18.
Joey meets Lincoln at the Playground before the castle mission, and their 'Why us?' / 'all they've got' exchange is from S3#9 (Closure).

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#9
value.text: Lance Hunter knocks out Agent 33 just before she can execute Skye in Vancouver.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The agent who stops Kara executing Skye.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A Hydra agent who nearly executes Skye.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#20
split.text: Kara helps Grant Ward kidnap Hunter's ex-wife Bobbi.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The agent who stops Kara executing Skye.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A Hydra agent who nearly executes Skye and kidnaps Hunter's ex-wife Bobbi.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#22
split.text: After Kara and Ward torture Bobbi, Hunter comes to her rescue.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The agent who stops Kara executing Skye, then rescues Bobbi from her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A Hydra agent who nearly executes Skye and tortures Hunter's ex-wife Bobbi.

verdicts.why: S2#9 is right, but the S2#20 split also told of the torture (S2#21) and Hunter's rescue (S2#22); the kidnapping stays at S2#20 and the rest moves to S2#22.
Agent 33, posing as May, plants the virus on the Bus that Fitz and Hunter stop in S2#4; she holds a knife to Fitz's throat in S2#18.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#3
value.text: After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Phil Coulson asks Agent Kara Palamas to come back, but HYDRA abducts and brainwashes her first.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4
split.text: As Agent 33, Kara fights Coulson's team for Daniel Whitehall.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The director who wants Kara back before Hydra brainwashes her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Coulson wants back, brainwashed by Hydra into Agent 33.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#20
split.text: Kara turns on Coulson's team again, this time for Grant Ward.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The director who wants Kara back before Hydra brainwashes her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Coulson wants back, brainwashed by Hydra into Agent 33.

verdicts.why: S2#3 (Coulson comes back empty-handed, Kara shown brainwashed) and S2#4 are right, but she fights Coulson's people for Ward only after Whitehall dies, betraying them in S2#20, so 'later for Grant Ward' moves to its own stage.

In S2#3 Agent 33 only drops paperwork off for Whitehall while Bakshi is in the room; she first works at Bakshi's side on the S2#4 painting mission, so the relationship as described starts in S2#4, where it already is.
Kebo greets the bloodied 'Richy' after the fight-club test in S3#3; the box of guns is S3#4.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
value.text: Phil Coulson recruits Lance Hunter as a mercenary, and Hunter becomes one of his most loyal agents. When Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. takes over, Hunter signs on for good and goes on the run with Coulson.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The director who recruits Hunter and whom he follows on the run.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A mercenary Coulson recruits, who becomes one of his most loyal agents.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#16
split.text: Hunter hides out with Coulson at the Retreat.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The director who recruits Hunter and whom he follows on the run.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A mercenary Coulson recruits, who becomes one of his most loyal agents.

verdicts.why: Hunter signs his napkin contract with Coulson at the beach bar in S2#15, but they go to the Retreat only in S2#16, so that part becomes its own stage.
Fitz first appears in S7 at the end of S7#12, coming through the portal to the regrouped team in 1983.
Mike returns in S2#16; after the S2#19 rescue, Fitz and Simmons promise him at the Playground that they will rebuild his stripped cybernetic parts.
Gonzales's recruiting line and Fitz's refusal and exit with the Toolbox are in S2#16; Coulson, Hunter and Mike pick Fitz up in S2#18.
Lincoln and May save Skye from Alisha Whitley's duplicates on the Iliad in S2#22.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#7
value.text: Lincoln accepts Coulson's offer to stay and joins his S.H.I.E.L.D.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Lincoln's director, whose team Lincoln joins.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman who joins Coulson's team.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#22
split.text: Lincoln, one of Coulson's Secret Warriors, gives his life to stop Hive.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Lincoln's director, whose team Lincoln joins before dying to stop Hive.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A Secret Warrior on Coulson's team, who gives his life to stop Hive.

verdicts.why: S3#7 is right for Lincoln taking Coulson's offer, but the text and cards also told of his death stopping Hive in S3#22; that part moves to its own stage.
Mike is back in S2#16 while May is on Gonzales's side; May is on the S2#19 team that frees him from List's base.
May admits her feelings for Coulson in S5#17 (The Honeymoon) and goes with him to Tahiti in S5#22.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#16
value.text: Hand reroutes the Bus to the Hub and orders everyone aboard except Coulson killed.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A commander who orders May and the team killed.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's pilot, whom Hand orders killed.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#17
split.text: During the Hydra Uprising, it comes out that Hand ordered the kill believing May and the team may be Hydra.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A commander who doubts May's loyalty during the Hydra Uprising.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's pilot, whose loyalty Hand doubts.

verdicts.why: The kill order is at the end of S1#16, but Hand's reason (she thinks Coulson's team is Hydra) and the Hydra Uprising come out only in S1#17, so they move to an S1#17 stage.
In S3#4 Werner holds Garner hostage on Ward's orders so May will let Ward go; the Kebo rescue and the Lash reveal are S3#6.
Quinn has the Cybertek leg fitted to Mike and orders him to kill Skye, which he refuses as not his orders, in S1#13 (T.R.A.C.K.S.).
